title: packages: DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id deletes unattributed (no actor), and the in-process deletePackage leaves the per-environment disable record behind
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(b) a defect with a named consumer**, measured by the objectstack-ai/cloud#3656 dev (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3686, report on that card). Platform defects go to the platform: 「平台的问题应该在平台处理」 (objectstack#30765).

## 维护者速读

在 Studio 里删除一个应用时，审计日志记不下是谁删的：删除接口没有把操作人传下去，而发布、回滚等其他包操作都传了。另外，从平台内部调用删除（cloud 的 AI 工具、本地安装、导入都走这条路），不会清掉「此包在本环境已停用」的记录，以后重装同一个包时可能一装上就是停用状态。

## Measured (pin `c50e0dfa`, code read)

- `runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` ~3068: the DELETE arm calls `protocol.deletePackage({ packageId, keepData })` with no actor. `resolvePackageWriteActor` (`packages.ts:408`, ADR-0146 D1) is used by publish-drafts, discard-drafts, revert, rollback, adopt-orphans and duplicate. The `sys_packages` delete (package service `delete(id)`) carries no actor either.
- `protocol.deletePackage` does not clear the per-environment disable record (`setPackageDisabled`); only the HTTP door clears it.

## Expected

- The DELETE door resolves the actor as its siblings do, and both the metadata deletes and the `sys_packages` delete are attributed in `sys_audit_log`.
- Clearing the disable record moves into the uninstall verb, so every caller gets it.

## Acceptance

- Tests: a Studio delete writes audit rows naming the person; an in-process delete followed by a reinstall leaves the package enabled.

Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3656 (its tool passes an actor and calls the in-process verb).

Suggested-grade: p2.

Dedupe (2026-11-06): `package delete actor audit` → 363 hits, the top 3 QA runs; `deletePackage disable` → 22, the top 3 closed (#28408, #27395, #26857 are other uninstall defects). None covers this.
